name: Pac Ngoi
kicker: Tay stilt village on the Leng
summary: Pac Ngoi is the Tay stilt village where you sleep on the Leng, against the lake. The morning boat leaves from the houses. Nearly 100 stilt roofs and about 40 residents are not the same count. Book the meal. The stay is a homestay, and the fee is Check on arrival.
getThere: On the Leng, against the lake. Gate-to-house minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: Stilt houses on the Leng, with the water in front and forest on the cliff

notice.title: Few stores in the hamlet
notice.body: Book the meal with the house and carry water.

body: You sleep in a Tay stilt house on the Leng, where it meets the lake. The village is in xa Ba Be, Thai Nguyen. Older lines still place it in xa Nam Mau, huyen Ba Be, Bac Kan. Nearly 100 stilt roofs stand here, some a century old, and about 80 percent of the old stilt houses are still standing. About 40 residents is a different count, not a second roof tally. Nearly 60 homestay households were counted in the old Nam Mau commune. A room that looks at the lake is one of the houses. Fuller facilities sit 1–2 km off the shore at the park gate.

The day starts with the house meal and the walk to the landing. The house may offer a walk, weaving, an instrument, or fishing. After the meal, then singing and the đàn tính are the evening when the hamlet troupe is called, with leaf-yeast wine. The hour the village goes quiet is Check on arrival.

figures.caption: Then singing on a stilt-house porch, with the lake and the fields behind
figures.alt: Then singing on a stilt-house porch above rice fields and Ba Be Lake

gettingThere: The village is the base, on the Leng against the lake. A last-mile motorbike runs from the park gate into the village. Minutes from the gate to the house are Check on arrival. Cho Ra is the commune on the north edge. The 5 km figure is the distance to Puong, not a measured walk from the market to these houses.

legs.heading: From the park gate
legs.body: A last-mile motorbike runs from the gate into the village. Fuller facilities sit 1–2 km off the shore. Minutes and a fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By road. The kilometre counts from Hanoi disagree, and they stop short of the village. The last minutes are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: The stay is a homestay, not a sight ticket. No room rate is fixed here. The fee is Check on arrival.
